text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the first day of summer camp.
We'll be
starting a more rigorous routine
to further
improve performance.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You there! Hurry and take your bags to
your
room!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You there! You'll have time to chat later!
We
have the introductory speeches at
the main
building soon!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And you! Hurry to your roo—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That was dangerous! I almost made a
mistake and
sent you to your room!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But of course!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Training camps are where class
representatives
shine! We get to show
off our skills such as
leadership,
management, and keeping the peace!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, busy, busy! It's not easy being a
model
student!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Obviously, I'm capable of handling both

flawlessl—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
AAAH! You over there! What are you up
to?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Going to the beach is still off-limits! I
won't let
you through without
permission!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Erm... Okay. Then... may I go to the
beach?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you asking me for permission?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You depend on me that much? In that
case, I can
hardly refute such
earnestness!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I permit it! Go ahead!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
HEY! What do think you're doing,
Sakura
Bakushin O?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Teacher! Did you see that? My judgment
was
incredible, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to call me Master Class Rep
from now
on if you like!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: What in blazes are you talking about?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begins Sakura Bakushin O's
passionate (?)
summer camp.
